nodes.speaker: Bob
nodes.text: Sidearms are in the locker. Manager's orders, some insurance thing, just for today. So it had better be quiet.

nodes.speaker: Bob
nodes.text: Nine years on this floor. I don't look tired. This is my face.

nodes.speaker: Bob
nodes.text: Don't look at me. Look at the floor.

nodes.speaker: Bob
nodes.text: Hands are up. That's the job today, apparently.
